# v0.9.0 — Worker repair and on-demand reports

2026-09-12 (UTC) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/yyyz1011/sheetdelta/releases/tag/v0.9.0)

## Changes

Dedicated repair and report workers with cancellation and deadlines. React/Vue examples generate reports only on download, cache unchanged reports and select source cells directly from issues. Worker payloads omit unrelated result arrays.

## Installation and upgrade

Install this version:

```sh
npm install sheetdelta-core@0.9.0
```

Review the [migration guide](../migration) and [related usage guide](../worker-imports) before upgrading. This is a summary of released changes, not a claim of support for every Excel feature.
